Independently validated all 68 listed tangents meet B exactly once and f-value vectors match x^7, x^9+x^5, x^7+2x^3. polylog.py PASSES in ~6s: monomial N in {1,8,12,13}, binomial in {1,8,10,11,12,13}, trinomial in {8,10,11,12,13}, deg<=6 normalized in {1,11,12,13}, N=9 count 0 in all families, controls N=8/10/11 OK. Normalization lemmas verified: f->a*f+m*x+c sends slopes s->a*s+m (bijection preserving N), so monic trinomials cover all 3-term and normalized x^d+...+c2*x^2 cover all deg<=6; complement of (<=3 terms OR deg<=6) is (>=4 terms AND deg>=7), so Theorem 2 implication holds for graph-type Redei sets. Finite exact certificates (proof by exhaustive exact arithmetic), honestly scoped: size 22 open, no PGL-uniqueness claimed. Minor scope nuance (graph-type vs cardinality-only Redei where vertical point in B could allow non-graph affine part) does not falsify any computed exclusion; recorded as limitation.
